title: Nirmata: Trajectory-Aware Evaluation and Delegated Authority for AI Agents
description:
Nirmata is an independent research program for evaluating AI agents from execution trajectories, delegated-authority events, tool calls, state transitions, and external effects in addition to final outputs.

No blind confirmatory result is claimed. See the evidence ledger in the repository for the current evidence boundary.
